scripts.create-admin: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d coursehunt -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto; WITH nu AS (INSERT INTO \"user\" (id, name, email, \"emailVerified\") VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'Admin User', 'admin@example.com', true) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING id), nc AS (INSERT INTO credentials (user_id, password_hash) SELECT id, crypt('admin123456', gen_salt('bf')) FROM nu ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET password_hash = EXCLUDED.password_hash) INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT nu.id, r.id FROM nu, roles r WHERE r.name = 'admin' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;"
